_about: Chunks withheld from BOTH indexes (Qdrant and BM25) by vector_db.load_and_chunk_data. Subtractive only: nothing here adds or changes a fact. Source: rows marked 'remove' in backend/eval/expert/corpus_fact_sheet_reviewed_v2.csv (review of 2026-09-30). STATUS: that review is NOT yet confirmed as the agri expert's own row-by-row judgment -- parts of it read as AI-drafted. Until confirmed, do not describe these exclusions as expert-verified. Removing a chunk can only make the system refuse more, so it is applied now; the reverse (adding the review's replacement doses) is NOT done and must wait for the expert.
